listing.name: Rock Band Blitz — Rock Band Blitz for PC (static recompilation) (hedgey95)
listing.summary: Songs reportedly play start to finish with 3D/audio. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Rock Band Blitz Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. XBLA title 5841122D; song decryption keys from own console also required.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Setup.cmd obtains tools/recompiles from own RockBandBlitz package; player supplies song keys from own console.

warnings: Songs reportedly play start to finish with 3D/audio.
